create_environment_instance: create an Environment instance with a ShotCondition, reward function, and reference generator for TCV plasma simulation
reset_environment_episode: reset the Environment to start a new episode with fresh simulator state and generated parameters
step_environment_action: step the Environment with a voltage action array to advance the TCV plasma simulation by one timestep
get_observation_spec: get the observation specification defining the structure of measurements, references, and last action returned by the environment
get_action_spec: get the bounded action specification defining valid voltage ranges for TCV power supply coils
